rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant mass in all four views, so it has decent gesture clarity and repair integrity, but the body is too generic in section and too close to a faceted stepped extrusion to strongly satisfy neighborhood living. The green parcel is respected, but the mass mostly sits inside it rather than forming a more deliberate site figure. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly; there is no legible public void, court, or undercut that clearly animates the frontage. In plan and elevation the form is coherent, but across views it behaves more like a compact sculpted block than a programmatic street building with an active ground threshold. The references support either a central void/interlock strategy or a simpler setback/canopy street response; the current candidate lands between those, so the semantic brief is only partially met and program_fit_hard_pass must fail.
